contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [---]VS PF AVG ; R/ [GLORIA] EXERC ITVS

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Arles mint, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust diademed and possibly cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---]VS PF AVG. Reverse description: two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA] EXERC ITVS. In exergue: *CON[S]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 17.6mm, Weight: 1.93gms, die axis: 12
